title: Finite-difference isoperimetric inequality for V(r) = L(G ∩ B̄_r(y))
statement:
Let m ∈ ℕ with m ≥ 1. Let D, G ⊆ ℝ^{m+1} with G Borel (MeasurableSet), μ a measure on ℝ^{m+1}, y ∈ ℝ^{m+1}, and ρ₁, C₁, c ∈ ℝ with c > 0, C₁ ≥ 0, B̄_{ρ₁}(y) ⊆ D and μ(B̄_{ρ₁}(y)) ≠ ∞. Write L = volume = L^{m+1}; powers are real powers and integrals are Bochner integrals. Assume:
(S) for every C¹ function ζ : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ with compact support, tsupport ζ ⊆ D and ζ ≥ 0, (∫_G ζ^{(m+1)/m} dL)^{m/(m+1)} ≤ c·(∫ ζ dμ + ∫_G ‖Dζ‖ dL);
(A) for all ρ > 0, δ > 0 with ρ + δ < ρ₁, ofReal(δ)·μ(B̄_ρ(y)) ≤ ofReal(C₁)·L(G ∩ (B_{ρ+δ}(y) ∖ B̄_ρ(y))) in [0, ∞].
Then there is K > 0 with the following property. Let V(r) := L(G ∩ B̄_r(y)), converted to a real number by ENNReal.toReal. Then V(ρ)^{m/(m+1)} ≤ (K/δ)·(V(ρ+δ) − V(ρ)) for all ρ > 0, δ > 0 with ρ + δ < ρ₁.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D G : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (y : Euclid (m + 1)) (ρ₁ C₁ c : ℝ), 1 ≤ m → MeasurableSet G → 0 < c → 0 ≤ C₁ → closedBall y ρ₁ ⊆ D → μ (closedBall y ρ₁) ≠ ∞ → (∀ ζ : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ D → (∀ z, 0 ≤ ζ z) → (∫ z in G, ζ z ^ ((m + 1 : ℝ) / m)) ^ ((m : ℝ) / (m + 1)) ≤ c * (∫ z, ζ z ∂μ + ∫ z in G, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ z‖)) → (∀ ρ δ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → 0 < δ → ρ + δ < ρ₁ → ENNReal.ofReal δ * μ (closedBall y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C₁ * volume (G ∩ (ball y (ρ + δ) \ closedBall y ρ))) → ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ ρ δ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → 0 < δ → ρ + δ < ρ₁ → (volume (G ∩ closedBall y ρ)).toReal ^ ((m : ℝ) / (m + 1)) ≤ K / δ * ((volume (G ∩ closedBall y (ρ + δ))).toReal - (volume (G ∩ closedBall y ρ)).toReal)
